title: Binary, Character Encoding, and Time
instructions: Answer from the lesson. For short-answer and practical items, equivalent technically correct wording/code earns credit.

questions.prompt: Why can UTF-8 text length in bytes differ from character count?
questions.explanation: UTF-8 encodes Unicode code points using one to four bytes.

questions.prompt: Why should an instant generally be stored with UTC or an explicit offset?
questions.expected_answer: UTC or an explicit offset identifies the instant; named time zones are needed for local calendar rules and daylight-saving transitions.

questions.prompt: Why can JavaScript Number fail to represent every very large integer exactly while Python int can?
questions.expected_answer: The language types have different numeric semantics; use BigInt for large JavaScript integers when appropriate.

questions.prompt: Convert binary 101010 to decimal and show the place-value sum.
questions.expected_answer: Bits correspond to powers of two: 1×32 + 0×16 + 1×8 + 0×4 + 1×2 + 0×1 = 42.
